Hey everyone,

So, I've had quite the week, and I need to vent a little. On September 28, 2023, we had this unexpected storm hit Galway. Imagine my shock waking up to Sullivan's Supermarket at 45 Main Street, where I work, being partially wrecked! The roof took a hit when a tree decided it was time for a surprise visit. Let's just say Mother Nature wasn't on our side that day.

I'm John O'Sullivan, by the way, and if you want to chat or commiserate, feel free to drop a line at john.osullivan@mail.ie or call me at +353-87-6593428. My poor store suffered some heavy damage, including lots of items getting waterlogged. We’re looking at a loss of around €18,000 in damaged goods and €10,000 for fixing the structural chaos.

Thankfully, Galway Roofing Services Ltd. is going to help us patch things up, and I’ve got to give a shout-out to my insurance company, Emerald Isle Insurance Co., for being on the ball. We’re working through the tedious claims process after submitting everything today, October 4, 2023. Let’s hope for a smooth ride, or at least as smooth as it can be when dealing with bureaucracy.

I've had this insurance cover since January 1, 2023, and it's valid until December 31, 2023, so fingers crossed we’re covered for this disaster. If anyone has gone through something similar or has tips on how to speed up these claims, I'd really appreciate it! 

Anyway, hope you all are having a better week than me!

Cheers,
John
